feature.description: Run the full task-to-PR workflow for this SvelteKit frontend.
feature.template: Use the feature skill for this task. Run the full workflow end-to-end: understand the task, plan, implement, self-review, fix issues found in self-review, finalize the PR when requested or when the task explicitly asks for PR readiness, then inspect available review output and report the final result.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

frontend-plan.description: Plan a frontend task before code.
frontend-plan.template: Use the frontend-plan skill for this task. Do not write code unless the user explicitly asks after the plan.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

data-load-review.description: Review SvelteKit data loading, local endpoints, and server-side API bridging.
data-load-review.template: Use the data-load-review skill. Produce a P0/P1/P2 report by default; edit code only if explicitly requested.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

affordance-review.description: Review affordance matrix and form save scope.
affordance-review.template: Use the affordance-review skill. Produce the checklist report by default; edit code only if explicitly requested.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

flow-debug-checklist.description: Check multistep flow, redirects, and post-mutation risks before PR.
flow-debug-checklist.template: Use the flow-debug-checklist skill for the current flow change. Focus on the real user path versus test setup.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

frontend-safety-check.description: Run the frontend PR safety checklist.
frontend-safety-check.template: Use the frontend-safety-check skill before opening a frontend PR. Report unchecked items explicitly.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS

pr-finalize.description: Finalize docs, checks, and PR to master.
pr-finalize.template: Use the pr-finalize skill. Do not merge without explicit user approval.\n\nTask: $ARGUMENTS
